mentions.name: ADME Property Prediction Tool
mentions.description: A tool that infers ADME (Absorption, Dispersion, Metabolism, Excretion) properties of arbitrary small drug-like molecules using a mix of machine learning models (an MLP plus several graph neural networks) and molecular dynamics. It ships as a standalone GUI program and is also split out into crates.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am trying to infer ADME (Absorption, Dispersion, Metabolism, Excretion) properties of arbitrary small "drug-like" molecules using a mix of ML (MLP + several GNNs), and molecular dynamics. As a standalone GUI program + split out into crates.
